findings.evidence: `JHolomorphicLineRotation.lean:76,84,91,102` introduce the bare names; grep shows many unrelated `toLinearMap` projections, while adjacent TauCeti API names the owner in `AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_transport` (`Transport.lean:105`). Mathlib naming says a namespaced definition may drop its namespace only when unambiguous; otherwise prepend the namespace in lowerCamelCase.
findings.fix: Rename these to include the owning object, e.g. move the first to `AlmostComplexStructure.isComplexLinearMap_toLinearMap` and rename the comp/of/iff lemmas with an `almostComplexStructure_toLinearMap` or similarly source-specific atom.
findings.issue: The names `isComplexLinearMap_toLinearMap`, `IsComplexLinearMap.comp_toLinearMap`, `IsComplexLinearMap.of_comp_toLinearMap`, and `isComplexLinearMap_comp_toLinearMap_iff` use bare `toLinearMap`, which is not an unambiguous definition name and hides that the map is an `AlmostComplexStructure` projection.

summary: One naming issue: the new `toLinearMap` complex-linearity lemmas use a generic projection name without identifying that it is `AlmostComplexStructure.toLinearMap`. No notation is introduced.
